origin.description: NA in either argument becomes NA. A non-positive count becomes an empty string.

arguments.name: times
arguments.text: How many times to repeat each string.

origin.details: The two arguments are recycled to a common length. An empty x is returned as is.
origin.example:
bp_strrep <- getFromNamespace("strrep", "backports")
print(bp_strrep("-", 10))
print(bp_strrep(c("a", NA), c(2, 3)))
